## Maya Chen — personal

**#1 must-have:** Insurance EOB translator.
**Why:** She cannot tell what a visit actually costs after the EOB.
**Build (3–5d):** one EOB → plain-language card. No auto-pay.
**Ask:** portal vs mail; who may call.
